observations.item: Project advisory pages (GitHub) for libexpat, zlib, lz4, zstd
observations.finding: Each page reported no published security advisories at fetch time (2026-10-06).

Security patch release. Owner reading: one High (CVE-2026-84782, DTLS retransmission buffer) and twelve Low (QUIC, X.509 extension caching, non-NIST EC curves, SM2, SSL_set_SSL_CTX, CMP, DTLS AEAD). A machine summary of the same page listed the X.509 extension-cache use-after-free (CVE-2026-84783) as Moderate and twelve Low; the page itself is authoritative. None of the listed titles concerns EVP_Digest*, SHA-1/SHA-2/SHA-3.
observations.disposition: API-scoped acceptance of 3.6.4: mmxisf uses only EVP_Digest, EVP_DigestInit_ex/Update/Final_ex with EVP_sha1, EVP_sha256, EVP_sha512, EVP_sha3_256 and EVP_sha3_512 (src/reader.cpp, src/writer.cpp checksum paths) and no TLS, DTLS, QUIC, CMP, CMS, X.509, EC or SM2 code.

observations.finding: Security patch release already contained in the pinned version; the reviewed titles likewise concern QUIC, CMS, CMP, DTLS, RPK and EVP_Cipher AEAD paths, none of which mmxisf calls (EVP_Cipher is not used).

limitations: The Windows/MSVC binary SBOMs of candidate X do not exist yet; the review must be completed against them.
A project page showing no published advisory does not prove that no unpublished or newly disclosed vulnerability exists.
Because Y is re-qualified, the review must be refreshed immediately before publication.
This record does not authorize publication.

owner.decision: Accept OpenSSL 3.6.4 for v0.1.0 with an API-scoped disposition; schedule an OpenSSL bump for the next mmxisf version.
